# Cancel digital cards

To instantly and permanently delete an Apple Pay or Google Pay <Term id="cards-digital">digital card</Term>, use the `cancelDigitalCard` mutation.
Deleting digital cards is currently only possible through the API.

:::caution Cancelation is irreversible
Canceled digital cards can't be reactivated.
Refer to [digital card statuses](/cards/concepts/digital/statuses) for the full lifecycle.
:::

## Guide {#guide}

1. Call the `cancelDigitalCard` mutation.
1. Enter the `digitalCardId` of the digital card to cancel.
1. The canceled digital card is returned in the success payload.

## Mutation {#mutation}

<a href="https://explorer.swan.io?%3D&tab=api" className="explorer-badge">Open in API Explorer</a>

```graphql {2} showLineNumbers
mutation CancelDigitalCard {
  cancelDigitalCard(input: { digitalCardId: "$YOUR_DIGITAL_CARD_ID" }) {
    ... on CancelDigitalCardSuccessPayload {
      __typename
      digitalCard {
        id
      }
    }
    ... on Rejection {
      __typename
      message
    }
  }
}
```

## Payload {#payload}

```json {4} showLineNumbers
{
  "data": {
    "cancelDigitalCard": {
      "__typename": "CancelDigitalCardSuccessPayload",
      "digitalCard": {
        "id": "$YOUR_DIGITAL_CARD_ID"
      }
    }
  }
}
```
